headline: Verstappen charges from 5th on the grid to win in Mexico City
standfirst: Max Verstappen won the Mexico City Grand Prix for Red Bull Racing, finishing 0.799s ahead of Lewis Hamilton, with Kimi Antonelli completing the podium after 71 laps of Mexico City.

sections.title: The start
sections.body: Lewis Hamilton lined up first on the grid. Leclerc got the better launch and led the field across the line at the end of the opening lap. The biggest winner of the opening lap was Perez, up 6 places to 14th.

sections.title: How it unfolded
sections.body: The lead changed hands 2 times. Laps led: Verstappen (28), Leclerc (27) and Antonelli (16). Verstappen took the lead for good on lap 44. The race was neutralised by 1 red flag (lap 45) and 2 safety car periods (lap 44–45, 59–63).

sections.title: Strategy
sections.body: Verstappen made 1 stop, running medium → soft tyres. The field made 39 pit stops in total; the quickest stationary time was 2.2s for Albon on lap 18. 5 of the top 10 finishers got home with one stop or fewer.

sections.title: Movers
sections.body: Liam Lawson made up the most ground, climbing 15 places from 22nd to 7th. Gasly went the other way, slipping from 9th to 17th. Timing recorded 273 on-track position changes, 28 of them by Hadjar.

sections.title: Retirements
sections.body: Alonso (lap 6), Stroll (lap 6), Lindblad (lap 59), Bottas (lap 43) and Bearman (lap 48) failed to finish.

sections.title: Conditions and pace
sections.body: It stayed dry throughout. Track temperature ranged from 34°C to 47°C, with air at 24–25°C. Lewis Hamilton set the fastest lap, a 1:19.268 on lap 50.
